Art for Equity Competition

legaleaglebee.com
Organized by Legal Eagle Bee

A free international student art competition run by Legal Eagle Bee, described by organizers as a prestigious, must-enter event. Entries are judged in three categories — Painting, Traditional Drawing, and Photography — and the top overall winner receives a $100 cash prize plus a Winners Page feature. It is the top competition for aspiring artists.
